name: NL8802
tagline: Nisshinbo's 2023 entry-level MUSES-derived bipolar dual: 5.5 nV/√Hz, 45 MHz, ±22 V. Japanese hobbyists rate it highly.

lineage.note: Launched 28 Nov 2023 as the entry-level MUSES-technology op-amp. Sole source; JFET sibling is NL8902.

part_numbers.note: Base part, launched 28 Nov 2023. EMP-8-AN SMD; DFN3030-8-GQ announced. No DIP-8.
Orderable EMP-8 part (Mouser, Profusion). 'AN' = package code; rest of suffix unconfirmed.

reputation.summary: A niche Japanese part with a small hobbyist following, marketed as the entry-level MUSES-technology model. Blogger new_western_elec (2025) preferred MUSES8820 for loud rock and NL8802 for recent anime music. One Japanese ranking places it above MUSES8820 and MUSES8920, below NL8902. No objective third-party measurements are known.
typical_uses: Audio preamplifiers, active filters, line amplifiers
Home, pro, car and portable audio
Swaps for MUSES8820 / NJM4580 duals via SOP-DIP adapter
caveats: Praise rests on a few Japanese listening tests; one verdict depended on genre.
SMD only (EMP-8; DFN3030-8 announced). Stability of a 45 MHz part on adapters is unconfirmed.
Only datasheet Ver. 1.0 seen; output drive, capacitive-load stability and full THD+N conditions unchecked.
Attribution of the hobbyist ranking (nw-electric or ns-kobo) is unclear.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeits known. It is recent and SMD only, so any 'NL8802 DIP-8' listing is suspect. Buy from authorised distributors (Mouser, Profusion, Japanese shops) and check the top marking against the datasheet.

datasheets.note: Lists EMP-8-AN and DFN3030-8-GQ (DFN under development). Possibly short-form.

claims_confirmed: Launched 28 Nov 2023 as a low-noise, high-voltage dual audio op-amp (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/20231128.html; https://www.phileweb.com/news/audio/202311/29/24901.html).

Entry-level model applying MUSES technology to a more productive process (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/products/operational-amplifier/spec/?product=nl8802; https://www.mouser.com/new/nisshinbo/nisshinbo-nl8802-dual-op-amp/).
5.5 nV/√Hz, 0.00005% THD at 1 kHz, 45 MHz, 11 V/µs, 8.0 mA, ±3.0 V to ±22 V, bipolar (https://www.mouser.com/new/nisshinbo/nisshinbo-nl8802-dual-op-amp/).
Packages EMP-8-AN and DFN3030-8-GQ, DFN under development at launch (https://www.phileweb.com/news/audio/202311/29/24901.html).
NL8802ANAE1S listed at Mouser (https://www.mouser.com/ProductDetail/Nisshinbo/NL8802ANAE1S?qs=jRuttqqUwMTBHsU0xW9tgQ%3D%3D) and Profusion (https://gb.profusion.uk/uk/nl8802anae1s).
new_western_elec blog compares NL8802 with MUSES8820 (https://nw-electric.way-nifty.com/blog/2025/09/post-02dac7.html).
refuted_claims: Not a 2025 product: launched 28 Nov 2023 (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/20231128.html). The EBV '/npi/2025/' page is a later distributor listing.
corrections: Launch date corrected from 2025 to Nov 2023 in tagline, lineage and status.
Blog verdict is genre-dependent, not an outright win over MUSES8820D; ranking attribution unclear; bass descriptor unconfirmed.
Added specs: 5.5 nV/√Hz, 0.00005% THD, 45 MHz, 11 V/µs, 8.0 mA, ±3.0 V to ±22 V, bipolar.
Packages resolved: EMP-8-AN (NL8802ANAE1S) and DFN3030-8-GQ under development; no DIP-8.
Added the Mouser Ver.1.0 datasheet mirror and a revision-history entry.
No silicon changes or PCNs found.
